renderDetails.messageTitle: Run npm create electron: Command may require input

content:
The command output has stabilized for 5s. The output delta since last check is:
npm warn exec The following package was not found and will be installed: @quick-start/create-electron@1.0.30

> npx
> create-electron trainer_frontend --template react-ts

? Add Electron updater plugin? » No / Yes

The command appears to be waiting for input: The command is asking the user to choose whether or not to add the Electron updater plugin.
